title: General Growth Balance - Synthetic Extinct Generations (GGBSEG) DDM — ggbseg
text: dt [data.table()] Input data, must include columns 'pop1', 'pop2', 'deaths', 'age_start', 'sex', 'date1', 'date2', 'cd_region', id_cols. Optional column 'migrants' included migration = T. age_trim_lower_ggb [numeric(1)] age-trim: lower bound 'age_start' included GGB (inclusive) age_trim_upper_ggb [numeric(1)] age-trim: upper bound 'age_start' included GGB (exclusive) age_trim_lower_seg [numeric(1)] age-trim: lower bound 'age_start' included SEG (inclusive). Defaults GGB lower age trim. age_trim_upper_seg [numeric(1)] age-trim: upper bound 'age_start' included SEG (exclusive). defaults GGB upper age trim. drop_open_interval_ggb [logical(1)] Whether drop open age interval falls within age trim bounds (GGB component). drop_open_interval_seg [logical(1)] Whether drop open age interval falls within age trim bounds (SEG component). id_cols [character()] Column names uniquely identify rows dt. Must include 'age_start' 'sex'. 'age_start' removed, columns define groups calculate completeness . migration [logical(1)] Whether 'migrants' column used. migration available reasonable quality, improves DDM estimation. However, data often available. input_deaths_annual [logical(1)] Whether input deaths formatted annual average recorded per year. Alternative recorded deaths entire period census 1 census 2. Default TRUE assumes deaths annual. FALSE, deaths divided decimal number years 'date1' 'date2'. input_migrants_annual [logical(1)] Whether input migrants formatted annual average recorded per year. Alternative recorded net migrants entire period census 1 census 2. Default TRUE assumes net migrants annual. FALSE, migrants divided decimal number years 'date1' 'date2'. method_growth_rate [character(1)] Method use computation growth rate. One : "hyc": Equation 8c Hill, , Choi (2009). \(r(+) = (1 / t) * ln(N2(+) / N1(+))\). "tr_iussp": Equation IUSSP website Tim Riffe DDM package. \(r(+) = (1 / t) * (N2(+) - N1(+)) / (exp((log(N1(+)) +        log(N2(+))) / 2))\). method_numerator_denominator_type [character()] Completeness point estimates population estimated deaths divided population estimated censuses. setting dictates ages population belongs . Must one : "Nx" : numerator denominator estimated population aged x. default matches GBD methodology. "nNx" : numerator denominator estimated population aged x x+n. matches Tim Riffe DDM package IUSSP methods.
